subject.title: fix(auth-health): prefer usable OAuth over expired inventory in provider status

question: Should a healthy OAuth profile be allowed to mask a separate missing OAuth profile at provider level?
rationale: Current source comments and tests preserve missing-auth visibility for configured OAuth, while this PR changes that operator-visible auth contract as a side effect of fixing stale expired inventory.

options.title: Keep missing visible
options.body: Require the PR to leave `missing` ahead of the healthy override and add mixed ok-plus-missing coverage for both rollups.

options.title: Accept masking missing profiles
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally let usable OAuth suppress missing inventory, but that should be recorded as a provider-status contract change before merge.

options.title: Pause for canonical scope
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the canonical stale badge issue needs this rollup change, the refresh PR, or both.

recommendation.title: Keep missing visible
recommendation.body: Require the PR to leave `missing` ahead of the healthy override and add mixed ok-plus-missing coverage for both rollups.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history points to repeated auth-health/status ownership and adjacent provider-auth decisions in this area.
